spin_fr.description: Wheel FR rolling angle; positive rolls the car forward

spin_rl.description: Wheel RL rolling angle; positive rolls the car forward

spin_rr.description: Wheel RR rolling angle; positive rolls the car forward

valve_covers.description: Lift both engine valve covers on their 3937/3938 hinges; 0 is the source pose

notes: Assign rigid groups and measured joints before setting status to ready.
Steering is a pitman crank: 16T/40T mesh (ratio -0.4) turns the crank about a longitudinal axis through (0,-54,-270) in the Complete frame.
Both knuckle angles are solved from the 100 LDU link closure, so the steering links move and both tie-rod distances are checked numerically.
The linkage is Ackermann: at a 21 degree crank angle the inner knuckle reaches about 25.7 degrees and the outer about 15.9 degrees.
Crank travel stops at 21 degrees. Near 36 degrees the outer knuckle reverses at the linkage dead point, so wider travel is not usable.
Kingpins are vertical through the 15460 ball centres that the suspension arms hold at y=-14 and y=-54; the steering arm is 20 LDU forward.
The universal joint is coupled 1:1. Its 29 degree offset makes the real instantaneous ratio fluctuate, and the joint centre 0/307 is left static because a spherical joint is outside this contract.
Each wheel has its own control; no differential is declared.
Valve cover pivots are the shared 3937/3938 pin point, not an estimate. Zero is the source pose; the covers already sit tilted there.
Ideal rigid kinematics: no backlash, friction, compliance or forces.

Sampled clearance: all four wheel controls are clean over a full turn. Steering reports six pairs and the valve covers two; both ranges are already set by those sweeps. See docs/validation.md for the breakdown of which pairs are inherent, which are measured contact and which one is a checker artefact.

Not rigged, with reasons: the doors have a verified vertical hinge line at x=+-160, z=-160, but the Sill Panel Door submodels interleave the static sill with the door leaf and no stud-level connectivity exists to split them. The bonnet and trunk lid contain no hinge parts at all. The rear axle worm and 8T gear, the gearshift and the supercharger were not resolved to a measured output.
